enrichments.summary: The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Marionberry Jelly Sticks DARK (item number CB745-D) sold in bulk 4lb. boxes due to undeclared Red #3, Blue #1, Potassium Sorbate, and Propylene Glycol. The product was sold to consumers from bulk chocolate cases without proper labeling.

The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Raspberry Jelly Sticks MILK (item CB747-M) sold in bulk 4lbs. boxes due to undeclared Red #40 and Potassium Sorbate. The product was sold to consumers from bulk chocolate cases in candy stores without proper labeling.

The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Raspberry Jelly Sticks DARK (Item Number CB747-D) due to undeclared Red #40 and Potassium Sorbate. The bulk product was sold from candy stores to consumers without proper labeling.

The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Lemon Jelly Sticks DARK (item number CB750-D) because they contain undeclared Yellow #5 and Potassium Sorbate. The product was sold in bulk from candy stores without proper labeling for retail consumers.

The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Marionberry Jelly Sticks MILK (item CB745-M) sold in bulk 4lbs boxes from candy stores due to undeclared Red #3, Blue #1, Potassium Sorbate, and Propylene Glycol. The product was sold to consumers without proper labeling.

The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Orange Jelly Sticks DARK (item number CB741-D) due to undeclared Yellow #6 and Sodium Benzoate. The product was sold in bulk to candy stores and then to consumers without proper labeling, leading to misbranding.
The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Orange Jelly Sticks MILK because the product contains undeclared Yellow #6 and Sodium Benzoate. The product was sold in bulk without proper labeling for consumers.

The Candy Basket, Inc. is recalling Lemon Jelly Sticks WHITE (item number CB750-W) because the product contains undeclared Yellow #5 and Potassium Sorbate. The product was sold in bulk 4lbs. boxes from candy stores to consumers without labeling.
